items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: And when we come, the boy, Charlie Allen, that was the man running.

ctx.x: Whose band was that? Your one?

Mine. Little made up band. Let me tell you what happened. I asked Francois who had the band. He wouldn't come, you know. None of them didn't want to come. So I got me a little made up band. And when we come, the boy, Charlie Allen, that was the man running. He asked them, did they want a wedding partnership or did they want a salary? No, man, no partnership. Let's give us $15 a man. Dick, they had a great big yard, see. And they pay at the gate. Down the quarter at the gate. And that yard was packed and jammed.…
